public_rationale: The records document a GAMA-to-Rabbit transition, an earlier $30 million funding milestone, and R1 sales. They do not settle the full assertion that the same legal entity disappeared on users a specified number of months before selling the gadget. GAMA released source code, and Rabbit describes an announced project transition. That does not prove continuing support, but it prevents treating open-sourcing alone as proof of disappearance.
limitations: The claim bundles several supported components with a less clearly documented customer-withdrawal sequence.
The $30 million milestone is documented; an exact current total is not.

public_payload.normalized_proposition: From what Zitron can tell, the exact same corporate entity that was selling NFTs and hyping an AI-powered metaverse platform is now, mere months after disappearing on its users, selling an AI-powered gadget after raising $30 million in venture capital.
conditions: mere months after disappearing on its users

statement.excerpt: From what I can tell, the exact same corporate entity that was selling NFTs and hyping an AI-powered metaverse platform is now, mere months after disappearing on its users, selling an AI-powered gadget after raising $30 million in venture capital.

from_speaker: selling NFTs and hyping an AI-powered metaverse platform
mere months after disappearing on its users
after raising $30 million in venture capital
our_interpretation: The opening qualification expresses uncertainty about a concrete historical account; it does not make the account uncheckable.
Disappearing on users means withdrawing meaningful company-led development and communication, not literal disappearance of every file or account.
Mere months means the late-2023 to early-2024 transition described in the surrounding text.
After raising $30 million describes an attained financing stage, not necessarily an exact lifetime total at publication.
The funding basis is company_reported because the surrounding text expressly relies on Rabbit's funding announcement.
The target period covers the earlier GAMA activity, the transition, and R1 sales through publication.
criteria.support_condition: Records establish legal continuity, the NFT and AI-metaverse activity, withdrawal from users several months before R1 sales, and company-reported venture funding of $30 million before those sales.
criteria.contradiction_condition: Records establish distinct legal entities, no relevant prior NFT/metaverse activity, continued substantive GAMA operations inconsistent with withdrawal, a materially different sequence, or failure to reach the stated financing amount.
